name: Joy
description: Happiness, delight, elation, or pleasure — from small contentment to overwhelming euphoria.

name: Sadness
description: Grief, sorrow, loss, disappointment, or quiet melancholy.

name: Anger
description: Frustration, rage, resentment, irritation, or righteous indignation.

name: Fear
description: Anxiety, dread, terror, apprehension, or unease in the face of threat or uncertainty.

name: Love
description: Affection, tenderness, attachment, longing, or deep care for another person.

name: Shame
description: Guilt, embarrassment, humiliation, remorse, or wounded self-regard.

name: Disgust
description: Repulsion, contempt, aversion, or moral revulsion toward a person, act, or situation.

name: Surprise
description: Shock, astonishment, bewilderment, or an unexpected disruption of expectations.

name: Longing
description: Yearning, wistfulness, nostalgia, or an aching desire for something out of reach.

name: Pride
description: Satisfaction, self-worth, confidence, or a sense of accomplishment — in oneself or others.
